subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: While crash-loop safe mode remains active, should a successful `secrets.reload` automatically restart channel accounts that were running before reload, or must all channel starts remain explicit operator actions?
rationale: Current main documents an explicit-start-only safe-mode contract, while this PR intentionally introduces automatic account restarts; code review cannot choose that recovery and message-delivery policy without Gateway owner intent.

options.title: Preserve Explicit Starts
options.body: Keep the startup SecretRef fix, but make `secrets.reload` leave every channel stopped under crash-loop suppression until an operator calls `channels.start`.

options.title: Adopt Account-Aware Restarts
options.body: Approve automatic restart of only previously running accounts, then require compatibility documentation and exact-head supervisor proof for stop timeout, rollback, retry, and delivery behavior.

options.title: Choose The Competing Candidate
options.body: Pause this PR and select the related open candidate only after its current head, proof, and recovery semantics are confirmed as a safer landing path.

recommendation.title: Preserve Explicit Starts
recommendation.body: Keep the startup SecretRef fix, but make `secrets.reload` leave every channel stopped under crash-loop suppression until an operator calls `channels.start`.

likelyOwner.reason: Their earlier crash-loop breaker work is the clearest available provenance for the safe-mode semantics being changed.
